The web half runs the cases through `neo test` (cli/src/commands/interface-members-parity.test.ts); the Unity half, P113InterfaceParityTests, runs them over a `neo export` of the same source, with the export's generated C# compiled beside it. class Bag<T extends Item, TTag> : IContainer<T> {
Probe.P.Pouch = new SeedPouch { Contents = [new Seed { Name = "a" }, new Seed { Name = "b" }] };
return Probe.P.Pouch is IContainer<Seed> && !(tools is IContainer<Seed>);
public static void BagIntoField() { IContainer<Seed> bag = new Bag<Seed, Red>(); Probe.P.Pouch = bag; }
public static void BagIntoAdd() { IContainer<Seed> bag = new Bag<Seed, Red>(); Probe.P.Racks.Add(bag); }
public static void BagIntoInsert() { IContainer<Seed> bag = new Bag<Seed, Red>(); Probe.P.Racks.Insert(0, bag); }
public static void BagIntoIndexer() { IContainer<Seed> bag = new Bag<Seed, Red>(); Probe.P.Racks.Add(new SeedPouch()); Probe.P.Racks[0] = bag; }
public static void BagIntoDictionary() { IContainer<Seed> bag = new Bag<Seed, Red>(); Probe.P.ByName["a"] = bag; }
public static void BagIntoBox() { IContainer<Seed> bag = new Bag<Seed, Red>(); Probe.P.Boxed.Value = bag; }
